subject: NexusHealth onboarding — contract redline + PO field mapping for Ariba
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Varga <sasha.varga@nexushealth.com>
Cc: procurement@nexushealth.com <procurement@nexushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NexusHealth onboarding — contract redline + PO field mapping for Ariba

Hi Sasha,

Thanks for starting the enrollment process with Redwood. Two quick items we want to align on before we complete portal activation in Ariba: the MSA redlines and the PO / EDI field mapping so your PO/ACK flow is clean.

Attached: NexusHealth_MSA_redline_v3.docx (proposed from Redwood) and a draft PO_Field_Mapping_NexusHealth.xlsx with our canonical fields. Can you: 1) confirm which fields on your side are required on PO creation (PO number, GL code, cost center, ship-to, bill-to, item description, quantity, unit price, currency, tax indicator), and 2) confirm who on your legal/procurement side will own the MSA review?

If we can get a short call this week with procurement + legal, we’ll lock the mapping and resolve two redline items that usually take us the longest (data retention + audit log access). Proposed slots: Thu 7/29 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 7/30 14:00–14:30 PT. Which works?

Next steps if no blockers: legal signs MSA, Ariba enrollment team finishes vendor profile, we push activation to your portal staging.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: NexusHealth onboarding — contract redline + PO field mapping for Ariba

Hi Jonas,

Thanks — I’ve looped in Procurement (procurement@nexushealth.com) on this thread and attached a sample PO file and our standard PO schema. Quick answers up front:

- Required PO fields from NexusHealth: PO Number, Line Number, SKU, Description, Quantity, Unit Price, UOM, Currency, Ship-To Location Code, Bill-To Location Code, Requested Delivery Date. GL code and cost center are optional on the PO but we can pass them in a custom header if needed.
- Legal owner for review: I’ll escalate to our contracts team but primary contact will be Mira Patel (mira.patel@nexushealth.com).

I attached: Nexus_PO_Sample.csv and Nexus_PO_Schema_v2.json (schema stub). Mira is out until Thursday but Procurement can meet Thu 7/29 10:00 PT. If that works, we’ll confirm Mira on the follow-up.

A couple of vendor-side asks after scanning your redlines: we need clarity on the audit-log access clause and the proposed clause for data residency/retention. Can your legal team provide proposed language for a 90-day audit log retention and a mechanism for on-demand audit exports?

Thanks,
Sasha Varga
Vendor Enablement, NexusHealth
sasha.varga@nexushealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

On Wed, Jul 28, 2027 at 11:04 AM Sasha Varga <sasha.varga@nexushealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks — I’ve looped in Procurement (procurement@nexushealth.com) on this thread and attached a sample PO file and our standard PO schema. Quick answers up front:...

Sasha — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the PO schema.

Looping in our legal and enablement leads to expedite: Laura Bennett (legal) will drive MSA negotiation and Olga Petrov (security/compliance) will review the audit/data retention ask.

High-level response from Redwood legal (summary of redline positions):
- We can accept the majority of NexusHealth redlines.
- Exceptions that require quick alignment: 1) Audit/log access scope — Redwood’s standard is 90 days of retained logs accessible via secure export; we typically provide hashed event-level records and on-request full logs under an executed NDA. We can propose explicit export API access with a 7-business-day turnaround for on-demand requests. 2) Data residency — we can commit to US-region storage for NexusHealth production data; any cross-border replications must be pre-approved via the change control process.

On the PO mapping: the only operational blocker I see is GL code placement. If NexusHealth prefers GL on the PO, we’ll accept it as a header field or as a custom element in the EDI 850 extension. Procurement, can you confirm whether the GL appears on your PO feed or if you rely on a downstream ERP mapping?

Proposed next steps (can be run as a mutual action plan):
- Thu 7/29 10:00 PT: 30m call (Procurement + contracts + Redwood legal/enablement) to confirm PO fields and finalize audit/export wording.
- By Mon 8/2: Redwood to deliver updated redline (MSA_v4) with proposed audit/export API clause and explicit US-only residency language.
- By Wed 8/4: NexusHealth to confirm PO schema final and provide test PO in Ariba staging.

If those milestones look ok I’ll draft the short MAP and share the MSA_v4 once Jonas confirms scheduling.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Enablement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

--
Laura Bennett

Olga Petrov

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: NexusHealth onboarding — MSA_v4 + MAP and Ariba staging steps

Hi Sasha / NexusHealth team,

Thanks for confirming the procurement slot and the required fields. Confirming Thu 7/29 10:00 PT is booked; Mira Patel from your contracts team will join if available.

Attached is MSA_v4 (redline) — it includes: the 90-day audit log retention language, the export API SLA (7 business days for ad-hoc exports under NDA), and an explicit US-only residency clause for production data. Please review the redline and let us know if any of the language is unacceptable.

For Ariba staging: our enablement checklist is below — we’ll need NexusHealth to: 1) add Redwood as a vendor with tax id on your staging tenant, 2) push at least two test POs with the agreed fields (sample attached), 3) confirm the GL code method (header vs ERP mapping). Once we receive two successful test POs and a confirmed mapping approach, we’ll flip activation to production.

Mutual action plan (MAP):
- 7/29 (call) — complete field mapping and redline open items.
- By 8/2 EOD (Redwood) — deliver MSA_v4 and integration checklist.
- By 8/4 EOD (NexusHealth) — provide 2 successful test POs in staging + confirmation on GL code handling.

If you can confirm the GL approach during tomorrow’s call, we can proceed with a tight schedule to enable billing by 8/10.

Thanks, looking forward to finalizing.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
